active_outcome: Explain retained adverse-regime failures for external technical review.
source_observations: Already consumed 2025 wave observations. Not a fresh holdout or prospective issuance.
hypothesis: Pooled calibration may underrepresent high-at-issue residuals. A strictly historical issue-regime calibration overlay may improve adverse coverage, with a possible width or interval-score cost.
support_floor_basis: Fixed engineering support floor for this diagnostic; not a power calculation, independent sample size, or coverage guarantee. No threshold tuning after execution.
candidate_rule: Keep the existing frozen point forecast and adaptive interval exactly as baseline.
Use the existing per-cell 2023 high-activity threshold and scale sqrt(1+current_proxy/frozen_positive_2023_mean).
At each UTC day boundary, calibrate only from high-at-issue observations with issue >= boundary-28 days and target+30 minutes strictly before boundary and finite original truth.
If at least 32 such residuals exist, compute the finite-rank upper 0.9 quantile of absolute residual divided by the observation's issue-time scale; otherwise retain baseline.

For high-at-issue forecasts only, use radius=max(original adaptive radius, conditional quantile times current issue scale); clip lower endpoint to zero. Ordinary-at-issue forecasts remain exactly unchanged.
No new feedback state is adapted. This is an interval overlay, not an independent reimplementation of ACI or a new point forecast.
causal_boundary: Historical timestamp ordering is enforced within replay. Original retrieval/forecast-seal chronology is unavailable; the 30-minute lag is assumed, not measured. No live availability is inferred.
target: WVHT squared times APD in m^2 s, a wave-activity proxy only

scoring.mask: Exact original Stage6 scored mask, preserving missing truth and horizon endpoints.
slices: each calendar month including empty months
scoring.summary: Report all 15 cells, descriptive paired changes, number meeting 90% empirical high coverage, and all width/score regressions. No inferential confidence intervals or significance claims.

stopping: Execute this one recipe once after source/protocol freeze. No retries with different windows, floors, quantiles, stations or metrics in this pass. Software failures may be corrected only with their failed run retained and a separate execution receipt.
